name: UK Geothermal Well Atlas - source file samples
note: These files are schema examples for real-data adapters. They are NOT development datasets and they are NOT loaded by the mock adapters. The mock adapters generate their records in code (backend/app/data_import/adapters/mock_*.py) so that a fresh checkout has something to run without shipping a file that could be mistaken for real data.

layout.adapters/: Where a real adapter should drop downloaded source files before ingest. Nothing here is read automatically.
layout.samples/: Schema examples. Field names match the adapters' expected shape so a real adapter can be written against them.

conventions.null_means: unknown. Never zero, never an average. A null temperature means the well has no temperature record.
conventions.status: Every measurement-bearing record carries its own provenance status: FACT | MEASURED | DERIVED | MODELLED | ESTIMATE | ASSUMPTION | UNKNOWN
conventions.is_mock: true for anything synthetic. This is the flag that watermarks the interface; a real adapter must set it to false.
conventions.licence: Record the publisher's licence. If terms forbid redistribution, the platform's no-index posture and tenant scoping matter more than usual.

files.wells.csv: Well headers. One row per borehole.
files.temperatures.csv: Every temperature reading, not just the winning one. Disagreements between sources are the point.
files.energy_prices.csv: Price book. Price without a vintage is an assumption wearing a fact's clothes.
files.regulatory_requirements.csv: Indicative consent requirements by jurisdiction and configuration.
